lede: Wrapstar Autostyle is a car wrap and film studio at North Spring Bizhub in Yishun. It changes car colours with vinyl or colour PPF, protects paint with clear PPF, fits window film and blacks out chrome trims. WhatsApp 9754 1833 with your car model and the look you want.

services.d: A new colour without a respray, in gloss, satin or matte vinyl that can be removed later.
Thick film in colour: a new look plus protection against stone chips.
An invisible layer over the paint you already have, against chips, swirls and stains.
Solar film to cut cabin heat, fitted to meet LTA rules.
Chrome trims and badges turned black for a sportier look.
Paint polished first, then coated for gloss and easier washing.

price_note: The $1,588 is the studio's posted starting price for a full colour wrap. Other jobs are priced by car and film: WhatsApp your model for a quote.

faqs: How much does a car wrap cost?
The studio's posted starting price for a full colour wrap is $1,588. Colour PPF, clear PPF, window film and dechrome are priced by car and film, so send your model on WhatsApp for a quote.
Should I pick a vinyl wrap or colour PPF?
Vinyl is the lower-cost way to change colour. Colour PPF also changes colour and adds protection against stone chips, so it suits owners who want protection as well as looks.
The studio's website shows colours from past jobs, from satin black and matte green to baby blue and bright yellow, and other colours can be sourced on request.
Where is the studio and when is it open?
9 Yishun Industrial Street 1, #01-82, North Spring Bizhub, Singapore 768163. Open Monday to Friday 9am to 6pm and Saturday 9am to 3pm, closed Sunday.
